INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

3. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

----
